summary: nVent Electric plc filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 15, 2026, disclosing via Exhibit 99.1 its pending acquisition of Maverick Power, LLC. The Irish-domiciled, NYSE-listed electrical equipment maker is the acquirer; no price per share, total consideration, premium, break fee, or advisor is disclosed in the excerpt, and closing remains subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions with timing described only as anticipated. The filing is a disclosure update rather than a definitive transaction document, so terms must be sourced from the attached exhibit and any merger agreement. Risk-arb focus: regulatory clearance timing and financing, with no stated walk-away protections.
